groups.problem: Asynchronous legacy writes inherit request cancellation and can be canceled before their intended timeout.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same context lifetime mismatch at the Create goroutine and explicitly extend it to the other asynchronous legacy operations.

groups.problem: Legacy.Update recomputes the original update against legacy state instead of receiving the result committed to Storage.
groups.rationale: Each reports the removal of the canonical-result updateWrapper at the same call and proposes restoring it with res.

groups.problem: Storage Create and Update failures are recorded through the legacy duration recorder.
groups.rationale: The same incorrect recorder is repeated in both Storage error branches; each needs replacement with recordStorageDuration.

groups.problem: Legacy.DeleteCollection measurements are incorrectly emitted into the Storage histogram.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same recorder call and the same resulting duplicate Storage observations and missing legacy observations.

groups.problem: Successful Storage.Delete measurements use the resource name as the kind label.
groups.rationale: Both report the same incorrect argument; inconsistent label series and excessive cardinality are consequences of that single mistake.

groups.problem: Successful write tests configure legacy expectations without waiting for or verifying the asynchronous legacy calls.
groups.rationale: Create and Update repeat the same testing omission, allowing either legacy goroutine to be removed without failing its test. Both require synchronization and explicit legacy-call verification.
